Eleni is responsible for the VPN gateway. Plus, João does not maintain the login service. An ID card is issued by the Passport Office in Novi Sad; a medical certificate is not issued by the Passport Office in Zalău. Carpathia Energy buys from Blue Harbor Media. Plus, Atelier Ciobanu buys from Greenline Transport. Chioma plans to go to the photography workshop. Youssef plays for CS Chengdu.

Ms Iordache is the boss of Mykola. Constantin plans to study history, and Małgorzata plans to study biology. The Passport Office in Nairobi doesn't issue a fire safety approval.

Dorin is based in Alexandria. Jun wants to learn chemistry. Tampere Logistics sells sourdough bread. Ana is the doctor of Sânziana. Plus, Felix isn't treated by Traian.

Iurie Guțu teaches piano. Ilinca lives in Brașov. Aurelia Rădulescu plans to study physics. Sibiu Logistics does not carry bicycle parts; Atelier Turner does not carry olive oil. Liviu has an allergy to shellfish. Burak Çelik is not the doctor of Parisa Tehrani.

The parents' evening is held at the Buzău Philharmonic. Plus, the Tuesday board meeting is held at the Old Mill Hall. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. Katrin does not have an allergy to strawberries. Plus, Xiaoling is allergic to bee stings.

Tamás isn't based in Lyon. Ioana is not allergic to peanuts. Harry plays for the Bistrița Wolves. I hope you are having a good day.

Do you know why Anna-Lena has access to the lab?

Out of curiosity, why is the analytics pipeline not out of service?

I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. The backup cluster depends on the booking app. Shirin Tehrani is on Plovdiv United, and Aditya is on the Oradea Wolves. Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here.

Marius Sârbu is employed by Carpathia Energy. Dragoș is on the Zalău Wolves. Yuki Watanabe works for Tisa Textiles. Plus, Elif is employed by Nordwind Systems.

Layla maintains the billing service and Aurelia maintains the inventory API. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me. Jun plans to go to the wedding reception. Olena is on Olimpia Târgu Mureș; Owen plays for the Hanoi Wolves.

Sofía goes to the regional chess tournament. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. The Last Ferry was written by Julien Bernard. Plus, Letters to a Young Engineer was written by Youssef Nasser. The Old Mill Hall does not host the charity run, and the Focșani Philharmonic hosts the spring book fair. Mircea doesn't borrow Notes from the Night Train.

Anca doesn't travel to Constanța. The Bergen Arena does not host the harvest festival, and the town hall debate is held at the Porto Arena. An ID card isn't required for a residence certificate.

Łukasz is not the boss of Andrei. Rădulescu & Partners supplies Greenline Transport. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Ms Balogun is not the coach of CS Deva and Bogdan is not the coach of Vaslui United.

Maria is the author of The Glass Orchard. I only have a few minutes before my next call. Tóth & Partners sells baby food. Delta Print buys from Atelier Kovács and Atelier Becker buys from Blue Harbor Media.

Alina Mocanu teaches German, and Valentina teaches geography.

Here is what I would like to check: Radu says Corina goes to the photography workshop. Does Traian Ardeleanu take part in the photography workshop? Out of curiosity, where did Lucía travel?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

Toma Ardeleanu is the boss of Mathieu, and Ms Iordache is the boss of Valentina Sánchez. Youssef teaches mathematics and Larissa teaches chemistry. Letters to a Young Engineer was written by Layla. Plus, Winter in Maramureș was written by Costin. The plot of land by the river belongs to Rémi. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what.

Manon maintains the backup cluster; Jack is responsible for the payments gateway. Elif maintains the inventory API and Carmen maintains the billing service. Horia has an allergy to peanuts. The booking app depends on the analytics pipeline. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while.

Orion Robotics does not carry olive oil and Pitești Logistics carries herbal tea. The Iași Tax Office issues a medical certificate and a criminal record certificate is issued by the Oradea Tax Office. Łukasz wants to learn geography and Harry wants to learn German.

Blue Harbor Media carries winter tyres. I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious.

What I actually want to know:
Verify the claim that the Suceava Town Hall issues a building permit.
Do you know how Laura gets to work?
I'm trying to find out which town Anca visits.
Hi! Traian pays with a credit card. How does Tariq Saleh pay, any idea?
Quick one: where did Rachel Turner travel?
Tell me whether Ms Sârbu is not enrolled at Pătrașcu Primary School.

message:
I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. A criminal record certificate is required for a residence certificate. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what. Carmen goes to the regional chess tournament. Plus, Manon goes to the spring book fair.

The garage behind the block belongs to Marius Nistor. Plus, the blue van belongs to Paweł. Camille takes part in the harvest festival. The billing service relies on the booking app. Adaeze Balogun maintains the VPN gateway. Blue Harbor Media published Notes from the Night Train.

Elena wants to learn German; Pablo wants to learn Spanish. Mr Yılmaz is married to Doinița Rotaru. Małgorzata Kaczmarek travels to Hanoi.

Mr Dobre intends to attend the wedding reception and Ingrid intends to attend the photography workshop. An ID card is required for a building permit. Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. Chioma is the spouse of Hannah. Vertex Analytics published The Last Ferry.

Emre works at Iași Logistics. Katalin is the owner of the bakery on the corner; the red Dacia does not belong to Mădălina. The Community Centre on Elm Street hosts the product launch.

Things I still have to do today:
- answer my emails
- call the plumber
- return the library books
- book the train tickets
- water the plants
- buy groceries

A few questions, then: Other than Daria, tell me who plays for Olimpia Suceava. The Old Mill Hall is in Botoșani? Background: Oana manages Liviu. Question: I was wondering whether Oana works under Liviu.

message:
Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. Octavian is not the author of The Glass Orchard. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. The spring book fair is held at the Community Centre on Elm Street.

Kostas does not give classes in history. Adaeze checked out Letters to a Young Engineer. Plus, Ovidiu checked out The Clockmaker's Daughter. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what. Mr Popa is not the coach of Olimpia Chengdu. Plus, Jessica coaches the Călărași Wolves.

Hiroshi plays for the Slatina Falcons. Jack is the doctor of Mr Sánchez and Gheorghe is treated by Mei Li. It has been a hectic week on my side. Laura is married to Moritz. Vikram is the doctor of Haruka Watanabe, and Jun is the doctor of Mr Lazăr. An ID card is required for a building permit and a work permit requires a criminal record certificate.

Mădălina is not the spouse of Daria. Corina is not responsible for the booking app, and Victor maintains the payments gateway. Olena is treated by Hassan; Ștefania is treated by Chloé. Brightfield Foods is in Lyon. Vertex Analytics supplies Voicu & Partners, and Orion Robotics supplies Lagos Logistics.

The Iași Town Hall issues a fire safety approval. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. Ionuț has an allergy to penicillin, and Elif does not have an allergy to ibuprofen. Oluwaseun does not intend to attend the charity run. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest.

The Szeged Philharmonic hosts the jazz evening. Mr Kariuki is on Buzău United. Joaquín García is the doctor of Ms Balogh. Arad Logistics is not based in Galați. Emil has an allergy to pollen. A residence certificate is issued by the Valencia Town Hall, and a driving licence is issued by the Bălți Land Office. The weather here has been awful all week.

Atelier Tóth sells sourdough bread. The weather here has been awful all week. The Slatina Tax Office doesn't issue a tax clearance certificate. Oradea Logistics buys from Atelier Manole. Montreal Logistics carries bicycle parts; Nistor & Partners sells winter tyres.

Manole & Partners does not carry olive oil and Atelier Diaconu sells baby food. Florea & Partners does not sell second-hand laptops. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. The Tuesday board meeting is not held at the Tulcea Philharmonic. Mr Navarro plays for Olimpia Cluj-Napoca.

Agnieszka raises Erik. Atelier Hoffmann does not sell printer ink. Emre Şahin wants to learn chemistry.

Seo-yeon isn't treated by Aditya. Atelier Nistor carries LED bulbs. A medical certificate isn't issued by the Passport Office in Botoșani. A birth certificate is issued by the Recife Land Office and the Leeds Tax Office does not issue a land title extract. Atelier Kovács does not sell school uniforms.

Rémi gives classes in physical education; Julien teaches computer science. The payroll database depends on the reporting dashboard. Crăciun & Partners is not based in Osaka.

What I actually want to know: Out of curiosity, why is João eligible for the bonus? I wonder if the Old Mill Hall is based in Vaslui. Honestly, does Kamau play for Olimpia Deva? Quick one: where was the town hall debate held? I need to know who takes part in the code review session. Out of curiosity, why does Liam stay home?

Hugo is allergic to penicillin; Kaveh is allergic to shellfish. Dragoș Țurcanu is the boss of Victor. The booking app relies on the billing service; the search index relies on the inventory API.

Kamau Odhiambo is enrolled at Chengdu Music Academy and João is enrolled at Oradea Music Academy. Mr Nguyễn works at Orion Robotics, and Viorel works for Greenline Transport. George doesn't want to learn German. Plus, Aurel wants to learn chemistry. Suceava Logistics doesn't buy from Carpathia Energy; Nordwind Systems doesn't supply Atelier Kovács. Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here.

Jack doesn't have a job at Atelier Schmidt and Octavian has a job at Delta Print. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me. Léa doesn't work under Liviu Diaconu. Mykola lives in Porto, and Linh lives in Chișinău. Esmeralda studies at Vlădescu Primary School and Ayşe is enrolled at Bistrița Arts High School.

What I actually want to know:
Vasile plans to study history, correct?
Kenji raises Mădălina Moldovan. — is it correct that Mădălina Moldovan is a parent of Kenji?

Samuel Bennett coached Olimpia Cluj-Napoca from March 1, 2020 until November 1, 2024. He coached Olimpia Cluj-Napoca as of March 1, 2020, right?

That is all the background I have for now.

Orion Robotics does not carry second-hand laptops and Wagner & Partners sells olive oil. My coffee went cold while I was typing this. Zofia travels to Lviv and Ngozi travels to Iași. Mr Turner raises Yuki. Hyun-woo has borrowed The Clockmaker's Daughter. Plus, Ana checked out Letters to a Young Engineer.

Otieno is employed by Vertex Analytics. The Bergen Tax Office issues a medical certificate. Sibiu Logistics sells herbal tea. A fire safety approval is not issued by the Vaslui Town Hall and the Nairobi Town Hall does not issue a tax clearance certificate. Popescu & Partners buys from Brightfield Foods.

Enikő Balogh is on CS Leeds. Tóth & Partners published Soups of Transylvania. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what. Javier Sánchez works at Manole & Partners. Things I still have to do today:

- answer my emails

Now, what I need to know: I need to know if Simona Barbu coaches Rapid Arad. Paweł Kaczmarek has borrowed The Last Ferry, and Seo-yeon borrowed The Last Ferry. I wonder if Costin Iordache did not check out The Last Ferry. Quick one: where did Larisa travel? I'd like to know where Lagos Technical College is.

message:
I hope you are having a good day. Irina Ciobanu did not check out The Quiet Harbour. Brightfield Foods did not publish Winter in Maramureș. Costin is the doctor of Esmeralda; Hassan is treated by Andrei. Enache & Partners sells baby food, and Iași Logistics carries bicycle parts.

Blue Harbor Media published Notes from the Night Train; Carpathia Energy published The Glass Orchard. Kenji is on Olimpia Focșani. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Enikő is enrolled at Novi Sad Arts High School. Greenline Transport published A Short History of Bridges and Sighișoara Logistics did not publish The Last Ferry. Owen does not give classes in German. Larissa is allergic to penicillin. Katrin Becker intends to attend the town hall debate, and Burak Kaya intends to attend the spring book fair.

Daniel checked out Soups of Transylvania, and Mircea Sârbu checked out The Salt Road. Rachel is on Rapid Pitești. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Layla is responsible for the search index. Plus, Rubina Lăutaru is responsible for the inventory API.

An ID card is required for a work permit. Plus, a driving licence requires a criminal record certificate. Léa is responsible for the payments gateway. Plus, João does not maintain the payroll database. Zofia plans to go to the photography workshop. Zeynep intends to attend the product launch. Plus, Aurel plans to go to the Tuesday board meeting.

Łukasz plans to study Spanish. Plus, Jonas plans to study chemistry. Dimitra studies at the Tulcea Language School. Plus, Oana is enrolled at Șerban Primary School. Rémi studies at Debrecen Arts High School. It has been a hectic week on my side. Valentina studies at Ardeleanu Primary School. Bogdan is not a parent of Julien. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Radu plans to go to the parents' evening. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. Dorin Pătrașcu coaches Rapid Chișinău, and Corina coaches Olimpia Chengdu. Dumitrescu & Partners sells second-hand laptops. Plus, Szabó & Partners sells winter tyres. Chioma is based in Lisbon.

Mykola maintains the VPN gateway. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. Ardeleanu & Partners buys from Plovdiv Logistics. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Rahul is on Olimpia Oradea. Tisa Textiles carries olive oil and Atelier Vlădescu carries printer ink.

Sânziana is the doctor of Tariq and Daria is the doctor of Hyun-woo. Vertex Analytics buys from Atelier Brown, and Nordwind Systems buys from Kraków Logistics. Cristina has an allergy to latex. Plus, Astrid has an allergy to bee stings. Alina does not want to learn drawing.

Atelier Stan buys from Botoșani Logistics. Lucía plans to study physical education. Pablo plays for Constanța United.

What I actually want to know: Given that Orion Robotics published Letters to a Young Engineer, it published Letters to a Young Engineer? Besides Kaveh, tell me who lives in Baia Mare. Quick one: how many schools is Hiroshi Suzuki enrolled at? I'd like to know which event is held at the Community Centre on Elm Street.

Thanks in advance!

message:
Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Liam Hughes has a job at Vertex Analytics. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. A medical certificate is not issued by the Alba Iulia Town Hall. I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious.

Laura is the coach of Olimpia Focșani. The Leipzig Town Hall issues a work permit; a criminal record certificate is issued by the Passport Office in Chengdu. Lin borrowed The Glass Orchard. Plus, Dariush has borrowed The Clockmaker's Daughter. Wagner Primary School isn't based in Cluj-Napoca.

Quang is on the Călărași Wolves, and Cosmin is on the Baia Mare Falcons. Alina doesn't maintain the inventory API. I will try to keep the rest short. A Short History of Bridges was written by Georgiana; Rubina is not the author of Letters to a Young Engineer.

Oliver Wilson is a parent of Hiroshi Sato. Gheorghe doesn't visit Târgu Mureș and Thảo visits Nairobi. Dimitra isn't married to Chioma, and Hugo Bernard is not married to Sânziana Mureșan. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. Youssef is the spouse of Ji-woo.

The Passport Office in Recife is based in Lviv, and Saint Luke Hospital isn't in Thessaloniki. Zeynep plays for Pitești United. The backup cluster depends on the booking app. Octavian checked out Notes from the Night Train. Mr Lazăr is responsible for the search index; Astrid maintains the mail server.

Ana is on Chișinău United and Raluca is on Rapid Novi Sad. Pablo Romero coaches the Pune Wolves. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Radu maintains the payroll database. An ID card is required for a building permit. Mircea has an allergy to penicillin.

Mateo is on Lyon United; Diana Oprea plays for Rapid Hanoi. Beatriz maintains the login service; Mr Kariuki is responsible for the reporting dashboard. A residence certificate requires a land title extract; a birth certificate is required for a driving licence. A fire safety approval is issued by the Botoșani Town Hall; the Craiova Town Hall issues a tax clearance certificate.

Julien Martin studies at the Reșița Language School and Joaquín studies at Bistrița Arts High School. The Focșani Town Hall doesn't issue a passport. Horia has an allergy to cat hair. It has been a hectic week on my side.

Tatiana is the doctor of Yuki, and Larissa isn't treated by Rafael. The parents' evening is held at the Iași Philharmonic; the Tuesday board meeting is held at the Community Centre on Elm Street.

What I actually want to know: Hassan does not plan to go to the harvest festival? Besides Jürgen, do you know who is enrolled at Arad Music Academy? Cătălin is a parent of Mr Dubois. So does Mr Dubois raise Cătălin? Do you know how many times the payments gateway was out of service?

message:
My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. The Passport Office in Slatina issues a building permit. Plus, a work permit is issued by the Zalău Town Hall. Réka Farkas coaches Olimpia Lviv; Tatiana does not coach the Plovdiv Wolves.

Ion doesn't maintain the payments gateway. Mr Smith coaches the Leeds Wolves. Olivia is on the Pitești Falcons, and Ms Enache plays for Deva United. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest.

Carpathia Energy supplies Delta Print. Atelier Hughes doesn't buy from Vertex Analytics and Suceava Logistics does not buy from Blue Harbor Media. Ms Krawczyk maintains the inventory API. Orion Robotics published The Quiet Harbour. The backup cluster does not depend on the booking app. The Montreal Land Office issues a tax clearance certificate.

Jessica isn't the doctor of Zofia Wójcik and Léa isn't treated by Corina Popa. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. Bogdan Diaconu takes part in the regional chess tournament. Zeynep Şahin teaches biology, and Larissa teaches mathematics.

João borrowed Notes from the Night Train. Plus, Oksana Bondarenko checked out Letters to a Young Engineer.

Things I still have to do today:
- finish the slides
- book the train tickets
- call the plumber
- pay the phone bill

A few questions, then: Check this: Sofía is not responsible for the billing service. Hassan pays with gift cards. Do you know how Cătălin pays? Is this correct? "Jürgen is responsible for the search index" I wonder if Horia Oprea raises Hyun-woo Lee. I need to know when Oana Dobre worked under Levente.

message:
It has been a hectic week on my side. Sofía visits Focșani. Carpathia Energy published The Last Ferry. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. Beatriz is on Rapid Slatina.

Lin is allergic to strawberries. Youssef is based in Lyon and Ms Farahani lives in Debrecen. Harry plays for Olimpia Lagos and Emil Voicu plays for Rapid Alba Iulia. Quang lives in Sighișoara; Cristina Dobre lives in Bergen. Marius is the boss of Gábor and Floarea Gheorghiu is the boss of Tariq Nasser. Ms Vlădescu is not responsible for the search index. Plus, Achieng maintains the booking app.

The spring book fair is held at the Community Centre on Elm Street. I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious. Seo-yeon intends to attend the wedding reception. The Târgu Mureș Philharmonic hosts the harvest festival.

Larissa borrowed Letters to a Young Engineer; Chloé Moreau borrowed Notes from the Night Train. Blue Harbor Media sells baby food. Elena is allergic to penicillin. Jessica does not have an allergy to shellfish and Chioma is allergic to pollen. Burak raises Laura Taylor. The Sibiu Town Hall issues a fire safety approval.

Thảo goes to the town hall debate, and Rohan takes part in the charity run. The backup cluster depends on the payments gateway. The Botoșani Tax Office issues a medical certificate.

Vertex Analytics published The Quiet Harbour. Plus, Brightfield Foods published The Glass Orchard. A building permit doesn't require an ID card; a land title extract is required for a driving licence. Lviv Logistics sells second-hand laptops. Nordwind Systems buys from Lazăr & Partners; Porto Logistics buys from Greenline Transport. Rémi goes to the Tuesday board meeting; Hiroshi goes to the parents' evening. Thanks for your patience with all my questions.

Jonas Hoffmann doesn't teach geography. Plus, Oliver Hughes teaches chemistry. Călărași Logistics sells herbal tea, and Atelier Oprea sells bicycle parts. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me.

Sorin lives in Cluj-Napoca and Ms Mureșan lives in Arad. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Ingrid manages Mathieu. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help.

Ștefania lives in Timișoara. I hope you are having a good day. Liviu is a parent of Kenji. Krzysztof Nowak isn't the spouse of Rahul, and Erik is married to Julien. Omar works under Małgorzata. Plus, Joaquín is the boss of Katrin.

Xiaoling is allergic to gluten. Plus, Aurel is allergic to bee stings. Mr Liu is allergic to ibuprofen. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. The reporting dashboard relies on the login service. Sânziana is treated by Ilinca.

Ms Florea visits Vaslui; Brândușa doesn't visit Piatra Neamț. Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Rachel visits Bistrița; Esmeralda travels to Thessaloniki. The weather here has been awful all week.

Things I still have to do today:
- water the plants
- answer my emails
- call the plumber
- finish the slides
- pay the phone bill
- return the library books

What I actually want to know: Background: Tamás worked for Tisa Textiles from September 1, 2020 until December 1, 2024. Question: Tell me whether he worked for Tisa Textiles on 1 September 2020. Up to what date was Hannah the boss of Carmen?

message:
This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. Mr Wilson visits Focșani. Delta Print sells olive oil, and Tisa Textiles sells herbal tea. The Lviv Land Office issues a criminal record certificate.

The Bergen Philharmonic hosts the code review session and the photography workshop is held at the Deva Arena. Ms Becker doesn't travel to Pune, and Adaeze travels to Arad. The red Dacia belongs to Kostas Nikolaidis. I hope you are having a good day. Linh does not raise Jessica; Kenji raises Marius. Ms Ungureanu is a parent of Mr Rotaru. Let me give you some background first.

Lagos Logistics doesn't supply Vertex Analytics. Ionuț plays for the Montreal Wolves. Plus, Mr Liu plays for the Szeged Wolves. The search index depends on the backup cluster and the inventory API depends on the billing service.

Ayşe studies at Nairobi Arts High School. Dariush plans to go to the harvest festival and Shirin intends to attend the charity run. Ananya isn't married to Zeynep and Aurel is married to Eleni. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. The Iași Arena doesn't host the regional chess tournament.

Turner & Partners is based in Suceava. The Old Mill Hall is in Vaslui. Plus, the Chișinău Land Office is based in Tampere. Thảo visits Plovdiv, and Jonas Schmidt travels to Slatina. A building permit requires a medical certificate.

Andrei is the boss of Ngozi, and Paweł is the boss of Jun. Traian coaches Olimpia Călărași; Brândușa is the coach of the Chengdu Falcons. Camille isn't allergic to latex. Plus, Manon is allergic to dust mites. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while.

The Passport Office in Debrecen issues a fire safety approval. The plot of land by the river belongs to Mykola; Can is the owner of the recording studio. Julien is enrolled at Leeds Technical College. Plus, Ms Wang is enrolled at Galați Music Academy. Kamau is allergic to cat hair and Attila is allergic to ibuprofen.

Things I still have to do today:
- pay the phone bill
- call the plumber
- book the train tickets
- buy groceries

Here is what I would like to check: Can you check whether an ID card is issued by the Passport Office in Sighișoara? Tell me whether João doesn't travel to Sibiu. Do you know when Zofia started to be enrolled at Lazăr Primary School? Can you explain why Levente is cleared for the lab? Okay so the Community Centre on Elm Street hosts the town hall debate. Quick question: is the wedding reception held at the Community Centre on Elm Street? Out of curiosity, why does Jack stay home?

Ioana plans to study drawing; Kamau doesn't want to learn German. Lin is the author of Letters to a Young Engineer and Beatriz is the author of The Glass Orchard. It has been a hectic week on my side.

Shirin Tehrani wants to learn biology. Joaquín does not live in Suceava. Plus, Daria is based in Chișinău. Chioma lives in Montreal; Mr Khalil lives in Deva. Mr Iyer is not the owner of the old sailing boat, and the red Dacia belongs to Layla. Rahul Patel is on Olimpia Lviv.

Katalin is responsible for the backup cluster. Atelier Munteanu buys from Delta Print. Plus, Tisa Textiles supplies Vertex Analytics. Orion Robotics carries sourdough bread. Thảo is on the Baia Mare Falcons. Thanks for your patience with all my questions.

Mr Țurcanu gives classes in Spanish. Larissa Oliveira travels to Constanța. Aurel goes to the harvest festival. Mr Bennett travels to Slatina. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while.

Hi! Małgorzata settles the bill with a mobile wallet. How does Otieno pay, any idea?

I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Burak did not check out The Glass Orchard; Léa borrowed Letters to a Young Engineer. I only have a few minutes before my next call. Corina is married to Hassan.

Orion Robotics sells sourdough bread and Brightfield Foods sells olive oil. Ngozi Balogun is the author of Winter in Maramureș. Plus, Quang is the author of The Clockmaker's Daughter. Laura works under Ji-woo. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while.

Carpathia Energy sells printer ink; Vertex Analytics carries baby food. Delta Print supplies Taylor & Partners and Szeged Logistics supplies Blue Harbor Media. Atelier Fekete carries bicycle parts and Tisa Textiles sells winter tyres.

Emil isn't enrolled at Lagos Technical College; João does not study at Toma Primary School. Attila visits Sighișoara. Dariush has borrowed A Short History of Bridges. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Ingrid lives in Botoșani. Mr Bennett is the coach of Rapid Călărași. I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious. A building permit requires an ID card. The inventory API depends on the booking app.

A driving licence is issued by the Nairobi Tax Office. Takumi isn't a parent of Brândușa Moldovan. Elena maintains the backup cluster.

Xiaoling Zhao is allergic to pollen. Lucía García isn't the coach of Olimpia Brașov. Ananya wants to learn Spanish. Plus, Olena plans to study mathematics. Chloe does not give classes in biology and Adaeze teaches geography.

Things I still have to do today:
- call the plumber
- return the library books
- answer my emails
- pay the phone bill
- water the plants
- finish the slides

A few questions, then:
Okay so Dimitra is the boss of Liviu Anghel. So does Dimitra work under Liviu Anghel?
Up to what date did Gábor Varga have a job at Bacău Logistics?
Sofía pays with a bank transfer. How does Rafael pay?
I'm trying to find out who intends to attend the code review session.

It has been a hectic week on my side. Orion Robotics sells second-hand laptops. Szeged Logistics does not supply Tisa Textiles.

Mr Zhang is enrolled at the Deva Language School and Mr Şahin studies at Târgu Mureș Arts High School. Ruxandra Diaconu does not want to learn drawing. Ms Phạm raises Zeynep.

An ID card is issued by the Slatina Land Office. Maria checked out The Quiet Harbour, and Moritz checked out Notes from the Night Train. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Mr Nasser plans to go to the photography workshop and Ms Liu intends to attend the wedding reception. My coffee went cold while I was typing this. Sofía is not allergic to strawberries. Plus, Mr Patel is allergic to peanuts.

Mr García is married to Victor. The Suceava Town Hall issues a medical certificate; the Arad Tax Office issues a residence certificate. The booking app doesn't depend on the billing service. Plus, the inventory API relies on the search index. Mr Walker plans to go to the spring book fair, and Yuki does not intend to attend the jazz evening. Tulcea Music Academy is in Cluj-Napoca; Saint Luke Hospital is not in Montreal.

Now, what I need to know:
Verify the claim that Horia Voicu is treated by Corina.
Greenline Transport published The Last Ferry, correct?
Simona pays with a debit card. What does Bianca Crăciun pay with?
Quick question: did Aurelia borrow A Short History of Bridges?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

message:
Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Seo-yeon isn't married to Gheorghe. Krzysztof is the owner of the plot of land by the river. Ana is married to George; Shirin Tehrani is not the spouse of Paweł.

Vaslui Children's Clinic is based in Pitești. Tisa Textiles buys from Greenline Transport. Jack is the owner of the red Dacia and the blue van belongs to Roxana.

Emre Çelik plans to go to the town hall debate. It has been a hectic week on my side. Chloé Dubois isn't the owner of the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street. Kaveh is a parent of Pablo García. Plus, Ilinca is a parent of Ayşe. The charity run is held at the Botanical Garden in Călărași, and the Old Mill Hall hosts the regional chess tournament. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Astrid Johansson maintains the billing service and Larissa Souza doesn't maintain the inventory API. Vertex Analytics does not buy from Brightfield Foods. Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here.

An ID card is required for a driving licence and a medical certificate is required for a work permit. Ms Fekete has an allergy to ibuprofen. Rubina visits Chengdu. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me.

Saint Luke Hospital isn't in Leipzig, and the Suceava Philharmonic is based in Bacău. Orion Robotics doesn't supply Nordwind Systems. Mr Barbu plays for Olimpia Botoșani. Aurelia doesn't have an allergy to strawberries. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush.

Carmen is responsible for the backup cluster. Glasgow Logistics doesn't carry olive oil. Plus, Carpathia Energy sells bicycle parts. Tamás plans to study drawing, and Paula wants to learn mathematics. A criminal record certificate is required for a residence certificate.

Jonas is treated by Lin. Aditya Sharma plans to study Spanish and Rohan Gupta wants to learn chemistry. The Glass Orchard was written by Ms Dumitrescu. Plus, Linh is the author of Letters to a Young Engineer.

Ms Navarro plans to go to the code review session. Novi Sad Riverside Clinic is based in Plovdiv. Cosmin doesn't give classes in biology. Plus, Aurel Iordache doesn't teach physical education. The Vaslui Philharmonic hosts the spring book fair. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Yuki Sato does not intend to attend the product launch. Mr Girard isn't the spouse of Attila. Hyun-woo is on CS Slatina; Oluwaseun doesn't play for the Piatra Neamț Falcons. Corina works under Chioma. Olivia works under Jun. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Kenji has an allergy to shellfish; Can has an allergy to cat hair. Olena Shevchenko has a job at Weber & Partners. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Sighișoara Logistics carries sourdough bread. Kostas has a job at Atelier Sârbu, and Ms Nagy has a job at Nistor & Partners.

Levente is on the Reșița Wolves. Hassan has a job at Atelier Vlădescu. Varga & Partners carries second-hand laptops; Valencia Logistics doesn't carry winter tyres.

A few questions, then: Mr Brown is allergic to latex? True or false: João Silva is not married to Ms Oprea. Check this: the holiday cottage in Bran belongs to Larisa.

That is all the background I have for now.

message:
I hope you are having a good day. Chioma is treated by Mateo, and Jonas Wagner is the doctor of Otieno. The flat on Mihai Viteazu Street belongs to Parisa Farahani, and Paula is the owner of the garage behind the block. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day.

Ms Balogun is enrolled at Botoșani Arts High School. Carpathia Energy did not publish A Short History of Bridges. The Călărași Arena hosts the photography workshop, and the harvest festival is held at the Botanical Garden in Montreal. Xiaoling Wang has an allergy to penicillin; Ms Bernard is not allergic to bee stings. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Mr Schmidt wants to learn biology and Zeynep wants to learn chemistry. Ms Kim maintains the payments gateway. An ID card is required for a building permit, and a work permit doesn't require a medical certificate. Laura Brown coaches Olimpia Szeged.

Atelier Nistor did not publish The Last Ferry and Blue Harbor Media published The Glass Orchard. Carmen isn't treated by Ștefania Vlădescu.

Here is what I would like to check:
Quick one: where is Ploiești Arts High School?
Any idea when Mathieu Dubois was the boss of Medeea Constantinescu?
I need to know if Réka is enrolled at Neagu Primary School.
Tell me whether Delta Print buys from Mocanu & Partners.
Quick one: how many people coach the Tampere Wolves?
Quick one: where was the spring book fair held?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

Things I still have to do today:

- water the plants
- finish the slides

A few questions, then:

Beatriz is responsible for the inventory API, right?
Tell me what Atelier Clarke sells.

Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Julien maintains the billing service. Omar travels to Oradea. Liviu goes to the jazz evening and Linh goes to the code review session. A medical certificate is not required for a building permit. Plus, a criminal record certificate is required for a driving licence. The bakery on the corner belongs to Ms Taylor.

Andrei does not maintain the search index; Can does not maintain the payments gateway. Oluwaseun Balogun visits Zalău. Plus, Elif visits Tulcea. I hope you are having a good day. Chioma Eze is the owner of the old sailing boat; the holiday cottage in Bran does not belong to Irina.

Brown & Partners supplies Vertex Analytics. Carpathia Energy published The Clockmaker's Daughter. A fire safety approval is issued by the Lagos Land Office and a work permit is issued by the Passport Office in Focșani. Costin is the owner of the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street.

Mathieu works under Hiroshi, and Łukasz works under Réka. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. Seo-yeon Kim plans to go to the regional chess tournament, and Nicolae intends to attend the harvest festival. Turner & Partners did not publish A Short History of Bridges.

Now, what I need to know: Background: Vikram Patel was the spouse of Lin from 1 December 2019 until 1 November 2022. Question: He was married to Lin on 1 November 2022, correct? Out of curiosity, how many people live in Bergen? Tell me whether Otieno Kariuki is based in Deva. So was Ngozi based in Sighișoara in 2019?

That is all the background I have for now.
